title: PET 瓶再生製程~PET-bottle recycling processes
focus: 瓶級PET的材質純化、乾燥與去污驗證~Bottle-grade PET purification, drying and decontamination validation
summary: 以「瓶級PET的材質純化、乾燥與去污驗證」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow bottle-grade pet purification, drying and decontamination validation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 原料來源與非目標混入~Input provenance and non-target mixing
units.mechanism: PET回收需記錄來源、材質及先前用途；看起來像飲料瓶不構成化學來源證據。~Record source, resin and previous use; a bottle-like appearance is not chemical provenance evidence.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：non-target fraction=12/1000；計算 12/1000 = 0.012 fraction。適用限制：假想已分類批次，非任何法定允收值。~Original hypothetical teaching example: non-target fraction=12/1000; calculation 12/1000 = 0.012 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical sorted batch; not a legal acceptance criterion.
units.verify: 比對進貨紀錄與分層抽樣中的非目標物。~Compare receiving records with non-target items in stratified samples.
units.failure: 只以透明外觀篩選會漏掉同色異材與不同前用途。~Transparency alone misses same-colour foreign resins and previous uses.
units.misconception: 透明容器必定是同一品質的PET。~Transparent containers must be equivalent PET.
units.practice: 在「原料來源與非目標混入」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.012 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只以透明外觀篩選會漏掉同色異材與不同前用途。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for input provenance and non-target mixing, first reproduce 0.012 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Transparency alone misses same-colour foreign resins and previous uses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 整瓶與瓶片的雙段分選~Whole-bottle and flake sorting
units.mechanism: 整瓶先移除大部分異材，破碎後再按材質與顏色精選瓶片，兩段的漏選不一定獨立。~Whole-bottle sorting removes bulk foreign material before flake material/colour sorting; misses may be correlated.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95)；計算 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg。適用限制：僅假設兩段獨立且同一污染群。~Original hypothetical teaching example: independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95); calculation 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg. Applicability: Assumes independent stages acting on the same contaminant population.
units.verify: 用同一組難辨識異材追蹤兩段漏選是否相關。~Track difficult contaminants through both stages to test correlated misses.
units.failure: 直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。~Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both.
units.misconception: 兩次分選必定提供完全獨立的保護。~Two sorting stages necessarily provide independent protection.
units.practice: 在「整瓶與瓶片的雙段分選」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for whole-bottle and flake sorting, first reproduce 0.5 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 瓶蓋與標籤的浮沉去向~Caps, labels and sink-float outlets
units.mechanism: PET瓶片與部分瓶蓋材質密度不同可分流，但黏連、氣泡及多層片會讓分離不完全。~Density differences separate PET flakes from some cap resins, but adhesion, bubbles and multilayers prevent perfect separation.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：PET recovery=475/500；計算 475/500 = 0.95 fraction。適用限制：已確認進料PET乾質量，假想分離實驗。~Original hypothetical teaching example: PET recovery=475/500; calculation 475/500 = 0.95 fraction. Applicability: Known dry PET input in a hypothetical test.
units.verify: 分析浮料中的PET損失與沉料中的異材。~Measure PET loss in floats and foreign resin in sinks.
units.failure: 只量沉料總重會把異材重量當PET。~Sink mass alone counts foreign resin as PET.
units.misconception: 沉到底部的材料全部都是PET。~Everything that sinks is PET.
units.practice: 在「瓶蓋與標籤的浮沉去向」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.95 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只量沉料總重會把異材重量當PET。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for caps, labels and sink-float outlets, first reproduce 0.95 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sink mass alone counts foreign resin as PET." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 瓶片污染的ppm基準~Parts-per-million contamination basis
units.mechanism: 低含量異材用質量比ppm報告；樣本大小與粒子分布決定小樣能否代表整批。~Report trace foreign resin as mass ppm; sample size and particle distribution govern representativeness.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：ppm=contaminant/product*1e6;0.015/500*1e6；計算 0.015/500*1e6 = 30 mg/kg。適用限制：假想乾瓶片質量比，非合格門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching example: ppm=contaminant/product*1e6;0.015/500*1e6; calculation 0.015/500*1e6 = 30 mg/kg. Applicability: Hypothetical dry-flake mass ratio, not a compliance threshold.
units.verify: 將大顆異材集中與均勻分散兩情境比較抽樣結果。~Compare sampling of clustered large fragments and uniformly dispersed contamination.
units.failure: 一小杯未見異材不能證明整噸無異材。~No visible contamination in one small cup does not prove a tonne is clean.
units.misconception: ppm值與採樣代表性無關。~A ppm value is independent of sampling representativeness.
units.practice: 在「瓶片污染的ppm基準」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 mg/kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「一小杯未見異材不能證明整噸無異材。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for parts-per-million contamination basis, first reproduce 30 mg/kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "No visible contamination in one small cup does not prove a tonne is clean." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 含水率與水解風險~Moisture and hydrolysis risk
units.mechanism: PET熔融時殘水可促進鏈斷裂；乾燥驗證應測粒料水分而非只記錄乾燥機溫度。~Residual water can promote chain scission during PET melting; verify material moisture rather than dryer temperature alone.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：water mass=polymer mass*moisture;500*0.0002；計算 500*0.0002 = 0.1 kg water。適用限制：假想濕度情境，非通用操作規格。~Original hypothetical teaching example: water mass=polymer mass*moisture;500*0.0002; calculation 500*0.0002 = 0.1 kg water. Applicability: Hypothetical moisture scenario, not a universal operating specification.
units.verify: 在相同溫度改變停留時間並測材料殘水與黏度。~Change residence time at equal temperature and measure residual water and viscosity.
units.failure: 料層短路可能讓平均乾燥條件掩蓋濕料。~Bed short-circuiting can conceal wet material behind average dryer conditions.
units.misconception: 設定乾燥機溫度就等於證明所有瓶片已乾燥。~Setting dryer temperature proves all flakes are dry.
units.practice: 在「含水率與水解風險」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 kg water，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「料層短路可能讓平均乾燥條件掩蓋濕料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for moisture and hydrolysis risk, first reproduce 0.1 kg water, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Bed short-circuiting can conceal wet material behind average dryer conditions." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 鏈長與黏度趨勢~Chain length and viscosity trend
units.mechanism: 固有黏度可反映分子量趨勢，但需固定溶劑、溫度和方法；不應把任意兩套量測直接比較。~Intrinsic viscosity tracks molecular-weight trends only under consistent solvent, temperature and method.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：relative intrinsic-viscosity loss=(0.8-0.72)/0.8；計算 (0.8-0.72)/0.8 = 0.1 fraction。適用限制：相同分析方法的假想IV數據。~Original hypothetical teaching example: relative intrinsic-viscosity loss=(0.8-0.72)/0.8; calculation (0.8-0.72)/0.8 = 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical IV data from the same analytical method.
units.verify: 比較相同原料在不同含水率下加工前後IV。~Compare before/after IV for equal feed processed at different moisture levels.
units.failure: 忽略測試條件可能把方法偏差誤認熱降解。~Ignoring test conditions can mistake method bias for thermal degradation.
units.misconception: 固有黏度下降10%必定等於分子量下降10%。~A10% IV decrease necessarily equals a10% molecular-weight decrease.
units.practice: 在「鏈長與黏度趨勢」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「忽略測試條件可能把方法偏差誤認熱降解。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for chain length and viscosity trend, first reproduce 0.1 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ignoring test conditions can mistake method bias for thermal degradation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 去污挑戰試驗的去除率~Removal in a decontamination challenge test
units.mechanism: 去污試驗以指定替代污染物追蹤處理效果，單一容易去除的物質不能代表全部污染。~Challenge tests track specified surrogate contaminants; one easily removed compound cannot represent all contaminants.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：decontamination=1-Cafter/Cbefore;1-0.02/4；計算 1-0.02/4 = 0.995 fraction。適用限制：假想替代污染物；不是核准製程條件。~Original hypothetical teaching example: decontamination=1-Cafter/Cbefore;1-0.02/4; calculation 1-0.02/4 = 0.995 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical surrogate; not an approved process condition.
units.verify: 逐一計算不同替代物的去除並找出限制項。~Calculate removal for each surrogate and identify the limiting case.
units.failure: 只展示最好去除率會隱藏難去除污染。~Reporting only the best removal conceals difficult contaminants.
units.misconception: 一項替代物通過即可代表所有化合物都通過。~Passing one surrogate validates every compound.
units.practice: 在「去污挑戰試驗的去除率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.995 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只展示最好去除率會隱藏難去除污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for removal in a decontamination challenge test, first reproduce 0.995 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting only the best removal conceals difficult contaminants." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 殘餘濃度的最壞情境~Worst-case residual concentration
units.mechanism: 以明示的初始污染假設乘殘留分率，與適用暴露模型比較；計算本身不構成食品接觸認證。~Multiply a stated input-contamination assumption by the residual fraction and compare with the applicable exposure model; the calculation is not food-contact certification.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：residual=Cassumed*(1-removal);3*(1-0.995)；計算 3*(1-0.995) = 0.015 mg/kg。適用限制：教學初始值；不可取代法規指定情境。~Original hypothetical teaching example: residual=Cassumed*(1-removal);3*(1-0.995); calculation 3*(1-0.995) = 0.015 mg/kg. Applicability: Teaching input value, not a regulatory scenario.
units.verify: 讓去除率降低一點，觀察殘餘值的倍數變化。~Reduce removal slightly and observe the multiplicative change in residue.
units.failure: 四捨五入成100%去除會錯誤得到零殘餘。~Rounding removal to100% falsely produces zero residue.
units.misconception: 99.5%可以當成100%以省略後續計算。~99.5% can be treated as100% to omit further calculation.
units.practice: 在「殘餘濃度的最壞情境」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.015 mg/kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「四捨五入成100%去除會錯誤得到零殘餘。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for worst-case residual concentration, first reproduce 0.015 mg/kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Rounding removal to100% falsely produces zero residue." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離~Critical-condition deviations and batch segregation
units.mechanism: 有效去污依賴經驗證的製程條件範圍；偏差時先界定受影響物料與時間，不能靠成品外觀放行。~Effective decontamination relies on validated process conditions; during a deviation identify affected material and time rather than releasing by appearance.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：affected mass=throughput*duration;400kg/h*15/60；計算 400*15/60 = 100 kg。適用限制：只計偏差期間進料，另需追蹤設備持料。~Original hypothetical teaching example: affected mass=throughput*duration;400kg/h*15/60; calculation 400*15/60 = 100 kg. Applicability: Feed during deviation only; equipment hold-up also requires tracing.
units.verify: 加入設備持料量後擴大追溯範圍。~Add equipment hold-up to widen the traceability boundary.
units.failure: 只隔離警報時刻的一袋會漏掉管線及反應器存料。~Isolating one bag at alarm time misses material in equipment.
units.misconception: 成品透明就可忽略去污條件偏差。~Transparent product makes decontamination deviations irrelevant.
units.practice: 在「關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 100 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只隔離警報時刻的一袋會漏掉管線及反應器存料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for critical-condition deviations and batch segregation, first reproduce 100 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Isolating one bag at alarm time misses material in equipment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 批次放行與證據鏈~Batch release and evidence chain
units.mechanism: 來源、分選、含水、製程紀錄與分析報告需對應同一批號；未驗證的用途應保留限制。~Source, sorting, moisture, process records and analyses must map to the same lot; retain restrictions for unvalidated uses.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：traceable coverage=complete records/total lots;48/50；計算 48/50 = 0.96 fraction。適用限制：文件完整率不等於安全合格率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: traceable coverage=complete records/total lots;48/50; calculation 48/50 = 0.96 fraction. Applicability: Record completeness is not a safety pass rate.
units.verify: 找出缺少關鍵紀錄的兩批並保持待審狀態。~Identify the two lots lacking critical records and keep them pending review.
units.failure: 用全廠平均紀錄補填缺失批次會破壞追溯。~Filling missing lot records with plant averages breaks traceability.
units.misconception: 文件完整率96%代表所有產品都有96%安全度。~96% record completeness means every product is96% safe.
units.practice: 在「批次放行與證據鏈」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.96 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用全廠平均紀錄補填缺失批次會破壞追溯。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for batch release and evidence chain, first reproduce 0.96 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Filling missing lot records with plant averages breaks traceability." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
